name: scan_text
description: Scan text for prompt injection, data exfiltration, credential leaks and other AI agent security threats. Returns findings, a severity, a decision (allow, block, quarantine or allow_redacted) and inspection_complete. The decision is reported to the caller and is not enforced. This tool blocks nothing and returns the matched text of each finding in full, allow_redacted included. isError false means the scan ran, not that the input is clean. Read is_clean and inspection_complete in the result.

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: The text content to scan for security threats.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.desc: The input channel type. Affects which patterns are checked. Unknown channels are rejected (fail closed).

name: scan_file
description: Scan a file for prompt injection and security threats. Supports text files, images (with OCR), PDFs, and more. For audio/video files, returns a notice that DEEP scan is needed.

arguments.name: file_path
arguments.desc: Absolute path to the file to scan.

arguments.name: allow_deep
arguments.desc: Allow slow DEEP scans for audio/video files. Default: false.

name: scanner_info
description: Get SUNGLASSES scanner info: version, pattern count, keyword count, supported channels.
